about_the_game:
Creation background:

"One day, when I began to ponder the meaning of life... I decided to create a game."

"This is the story I want to tell you."

"And thus, my story with you all begins."

Regarding the game:

"Mind Detective" is an independently produced puzzle, drama, and interactive novel game. You need to follow six partners with different backgrounds, ages, and personalities, shuttling between the inner world and the real world, searching for the deepest secrets buried in people's hearts.

You will run a murder mystery game shop with these six partners, but apart from your main business, you also have a sideline - psychological counseling. One of the members, "Z", in order to better coordinate with psychological counseling, designed a program that can enter people's inner world. This program allows you to freely explore people's innermost thoughts and discover the secrets hidden in their deepest parts.

Thus, you embarked on a journey of the soul.

The gameplay is quite simple. Use the [Directional Keys] on the numeric keypad to control the character to explore the map, trigger the storyline or solve puzzles.

The story of the game is linear, with no multiple endings or hidden paths. There may be choices in the game, but these choices will not affect the final outcome.

The game may contain psychological implications, mild horror scenes, and elements such as bloodshed, killing, and face-jumping attacks.

The game will feature elements of chasing and maze content.

Operation mode:

Direction keys control movement, space bar for interaction, Shift to run, and ESC for menu

Zoom in on the F5 window, and press Alt+Ent to go full screen

Game Features:

*Unique visuals and narrative style!

*A more "Chinese-style" and more memorable plot!

*Six companions you'll definitely fall in love with!

*Rich original music!

Introduction to the main characters:

Name: Z

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Scorpio

Age: 25 years old

MBTI：INTJ

Introduction: The creator of the program "Peering into People's Inner World" tends to be rational and decisive in many decision-making processes, but he seems to have a less accurate grasp of "human touch". He usually gives off an indifferent and mysterious vibe, and he rarely expresses his inner thoughts through words. It seems as if there are some unknown secrets hidden within him ..

Name: Mou Duo

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Aries

Age: 23

MBTI：ENFJ

Introduction: She is a "store manager" with a straightforward and passionate personality. For everything that "needs" to be done, she always rushes forward without hesitation to solve it. When it comes to her best friends, she is always responsible and thoughtful. Perhaps to outsiders, she appears as an elder sister and a female knight-like figure. However, perhaps no one has ever seen her vulnerability.

Name: Wolf

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Leo

Age: 22 years old

MBTI：ESFP

Introduction: If you could meet him, he would definitely give you a barrage of words first. "My happiness is the most important thing." It seems that even if the sky falls, it's okay, because his mouth will hold it up. "Eat and drink, don't take anything to heart." Freedom and looseness is his attitude towards life, and humor and humiliation is a portrayal of his life. "So what, what can you do?"

Name: Fanfan

Gender: Male

Zodiac: Aquarius

Age: 22 years old

MBTI：ENFP

Introduction: A compassionate and lively cute little boy, nicknamed "Happy Puppy". He always exudes a childlike innocence, filled with curiosity and naivety. He is full of a thirst for exploration, seemingly endowed with endless energy, always ready to embark on a new adventure. Since he truly has no worries, he was named "Fanfan".

Name: Yuli

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Pisces

Age: 21

MBTI：ISFJ

Introduction: A simple and gentle, romantic and delicate "female college student" with a healing aura. She always takes good care of her friends around her. She advocates "love and freedom". Her heart is always filled with a sense of justice. She firmly believes that the world is beautiful. There must be light to illuminate those dark corners.

Name: Hua

Gender: Female

Zodiac: Libra

Age: 15 years old

MBTI：INFP

Introduction: She is the owner of a murder mystery game shop. Born into a wealthy family, she is known as the "princess". Her mother opened this shop solely for her hobby. As her parents are abroad for most of the time, she entrusted her sister, Mouduo, to take care of her. She is not very talkative. She has a solitary and introverted personality. To outsiders, she may seem like an ordinary girl. But... is it really the case?
